assumptionsAndDecisions.statement: Config key is `skills.csm-orchestrate.traceLogPath` inside the CSM envelope (not opencode config, which rejects unknown keys).
Default is <main-repo-root>/.agents/logs/trace.jsonl; the main root is resolved via the shared repoMainRoot so all worktrees share it and it survives nuke.

Precedence: CSM_TRACE_LOG env (absolute) > project/<repo> .csm-skills.json > user ~/.config/csm/skills.json > default. Project-over-user is intentional (per-repo override) and is implemented+documented explicitly (differs from resolveConfig's generic merge).
